{{Quote|We wanted to give you an Alliance banner as a reward for your work. However, since you managed to convince Tellulon's friend to join the Rebellion, I thought I'd give you two banners. May the Force be with you.|Verks|<ref name="SWG:EDR" />}}
'''Verks''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Verks was based on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During that time, [[Tellulon]], a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] infiltrated in the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Yavin Imperial Fortress]], served under his orders.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, Colonel Verks resided in the [[Mining Outpost (Yavin 4)|Yavin Mining Outpost]]. It was there that he met a group of Rebel spacers sent to meet him by Tellulon. The spacers were coming back from the Imperial Fortress where one of them had convinced an Imperial [[Technician/Legends|Technician]] named [[Arlo]] to defect to the Alliance. Verks, impressed at how the Rebel persuaded Arlo to join the Rebellion, commended him.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I need to visit Colonel Verks and update him on the progress of Tellulon's mission.|Quest journal text identifying Colonel Verks as a male|<ref name="SWG:EDR" />}}
[[File:SWG_rebel_colonel_Template.jpg|300px|thumb|Possible depictions of Colonel Verks.]]
Verks appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Verks was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found in the Yavin IV Mining Outpost and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Empire Day Revealed|Empire Day Revealed]]," which would send players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> After the live event ended, Verks never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>

Since Verks spawned under the generic "rebel_colonel" template utilizing six different Interchange File Formats, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, the quest journal identified Verks as a male.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />
